pageProps.content: ## Review The wait at the place we originally planned to go was too long, so we found a nearby cafe with a friendly name and walked in. We ordered brunch and coffee to have a light meal. It was quite busy and more popular than expected — if we had hesitated a bit longer, there would have been no seats. There were plenty of locals enjoying a casual brunch. The coffee was good, and overall it was a decent spot. It reminded me once again that even unplanned, impromptu stops can turn into good experiences. ## Pictures
